about: Battle menu shown on a party member's turn (the FFX turn concept; every move is KH2's own). who: sora, partner or both. attack is a plain melee strike for everyone; magic and techniques open that character's own lists (Sora: his spells; partners: sheets/partnerMoves); defend uses Guard and halves damage until the next turn; party opens KH2's pause menu so Party can swap a partner; escape only works in random encounters.

rows.label: Attack
rows.description: Step up to one enemy and strike it.

rows.label: Magic
rows.description: Cast one of this character's spells.

rows.label: Techniques
rows.description: Use one of this character's own techniques.

rows.label: Items
rows.description: Use one of the items equipped on this character.

rows.label: Defend
rows.description: Guard: take half damage until the next turn, which comes sooner.

rows.label: Party
rows.description: Swap a partner for this world's own partner (KH2's Party command). Costs no turn.
